# Apple AudioUnitSDK

Unmodified include/src source files, license and upstream readme from Apple AudioUnitSDK 1.4.0 at commit `bd98b31feff57a15989fcfab4cd86dc63382b1ac`.

Source: https://github.com/apple/AudioUnitSDK/tree/bd98b31feff57a15989fcfab4cd86dc63382b1ac

The SDK is Apache-2.0 licensed; see `AudioUnitSDK/LICENSE.txt`. VoicePrep's own code remains MIT licensed. The plug-in build uses the SDK's C++23 sources directly and does not need CMake or the full Xcode IDE.
